title: 2. Why is HITL needed?
summary: AI agents can make mistakes because of: - Hallucinations. - Prompt injection. - Incorrect tool selection. - Incorrect arguments. - Ambiguous user requests. - Outdated or incomplete information. A human approval step adds a control before a high-impact action is executed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
AI agents can make mistakes because of:

- Hallucinations.
- Prompt injection.
- Incorrect tool selection.
- Incorrect arguments.
- Ambiguous user requests.
- Outdated or incomplete information.

A human approval step adds a control before a high-impact action is executed.

steps.label: Goal
steps.narration: The agent receives a user goal and must decide what information or tools are required.

steps.label: Reason
steps.narration: The model plans the next action instead of answering blindly.

steps.label: Act / tool
steps.narration: The agent calls an authorized tool or function with structured arguments. A human approval step adds a control before a high-impact action is executed.

steps.label: Observe
steps.narration: Usage, cost, latency, and traces are recorded for FinOps and incident response.

steps.label: Decide
steps.narration: The loop continues, escalates to a human, or finishes with a grounded answer.
